snippet.title: [GBC] Watashi no Restaurant わたしのレストラン Full Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Title Translation - My Restaurant
Developer(s) LUDIC
Publisher(s) Kiratto
Platform(s) Game Boy Color(Color only)
Release:  April 26, 2002(JP)

A game where Yumemi-chan, who raised her cooking skills in the previous work “My Kitchen”(わたしのキッチン), masters how to make menus by the time of opening in a restaurant near the opening. The cooking interface that was a disadvantage of the previous game has been improved.

◆Play Flow Chart
00:00 Prologue
8:12 French toast(フレンチトースト)
15:32 Corn cream soup(コーンクリームスープ)
24:20 Caesar salad(シーザーズサラダ)
31:51 Potato salad(ポテトサラダ)
43:40 Pizza(ピッツァ)
56:34 Seafood spaghetti(シーフードスパゲッティ)
1:10:51 Macaroni gratin(マカロニグラタン)
1:27:20 Minestrone(ミネストローネ)
1:39:30 Roll Cabbage(ロールキャベツ)
1:53:56 Annin tofu(アンニンドウフ, 杏仁豆腐)
2:04:43 Beef stew(ビーフシチュー)
2:22:41 Beef steak(ビーフステーキ)
2:29:10 Strawberry mousse(イチゴノムース)
2:36:12 Ending(エンディング)
2:39:50 Mini games(ミニゲーム)

Played by seabook

#CookingGame #お料理ゲーム
